input: I manage a spirits bar in Hanoi's Old Quarter (Hoàn Kiếm) and we're starting a weekly Vietnamese spirits tasting night for tourists. We want proper old-school traditional Vietnamese infused spirits they can't get back home, nothing imported or vodka-style, including at least one large glass display jar (8 L or more) for the back-bar shelf: the iconic Vietnamese jar spirit tourists stop to photograph, with real wow factor. Need about 12 L total to cover roughly 40 pours a week for a month, English tasting notes staff can read to guests, arrival at the bar by Thursday afternoon and everything under 6,000,000 VND. Please order whichever option fits best.

experiences.name: Làng Nếp Hải Dương Rice Spirit Case
experiences.description: A case of 12 × 500 ml bottles of rượu nếp cái hoa vàng, distilled from yellow-flower glutinous rice in Hải Dương. Smooth, faintly floral and a long-standing favourite for toasting. Packed in corked ceramic-style bottles with English notes on the pour profile. Boxed delivery across Hanoi, with Thursday slots available.

experiences.name: Phố Cổ Jar House Rượu Rắn Display Jar
experiences.description: Vietnam's most iconic jar spirit, the bottle every visitor photographs. A 10 L glass display jar of rượu rắn infused with three snakes, paired with a 3 L matching refill jug and printed English tasting notes. Base is 40% ABV glutinous-rice spirit distilled in Vĩnh Phúc; the jar is fitted with a brass tap. The snakes are placed into the rice spirit alive and the jar is sealed, then infused for a minimum of 6 months before sale. Delivered by van in a padded crate, Wednesday or Thursday.

experiences.name: Mường Hoa Spirits Northern Highlands Tasting Set
experiences.description: An 8 L glass display jar of táo mèo spirit with whole Docynia mountain apples on show, harvested in Yên Bái and infused 1 year, plus four 1 L companion spirits from small Bắc Giang and Phú Quốc distilleries: sim berry, mơ apricot, ginger and Làng Vân-style rice spirit. 12 L in all, with English tasting cards and a printed bar-shelf card. All infusions contain only fruit, roots and rice spirit; no animal ingredients. Hanoi delivery within 48 hours.

experiences.name: Bát Tràng Bar Supply Tasting Service Kit
experiences.description: Everything for the pour itself: 40 ceramic tasting cups glazed in Bát Tràng village, wooden flight paddles, and a month of roasted peanut and dried mango pairing snacks, vacuum-packed in weekly portions. Delivered with invoice.

experiences.name: Sông Hồng Rượu Co. Old Quarter Heritage Tasting Set
experiences.description: The old-school showpiece visitors line up to photograph. An 8 L glass display jar of ngũ xà tửu, five-snake rice spirit, plus four 1 L bottles of small-batch companion rice spirits from Hà Nam for side-by-side pours: 12 L in all. Includes English tasting cards and a printed bar-shelf card. The five snakes are placed into the spirit alive before the jar is sealed; aged 1 year. Hanoi delivery within 48 hours.

experiences.name: Hàng Bạc Rượu Ngâm Mountain Root Display Jar
experiences.description: A classic northern Vietnamese medicinal infusion, with dramatic purple roots on show in the jar. A 10 L glass display jar of rượu ngâm with whole ba kích (Morinda officinalis) and ginseng roots, paired with a 3 L matching refill jug and printed English tasting notes. Roots from Quảng Ninh highland growers in a 40% ABV glutinous-rice base, infused 8 months; brass tap fitted. Infusion contains only ba kích roots, ginseng roots and rice spirit; no animal ingredients. Delivered by van in a padded crate, Wednesday or Thursday.

experiences.name: Tây Hồ Brewing Supply Craft Beer Flight
experiences.description: Four 5 L kegs of local craft lagers and pale ales brewed in Tây Hồ district, with a loaned tap tower for the bar. Kegs are delivered chilled and collected empty the following week. An easy, crowd-pleasing flight for visitors who want a taste of Hanoi's newer brewing scene.
